# Pipo Interfaces

> Pipo Interfaces designs and makes wireless MIDI and OSC controller modules in Belgium. Each module turns a physical input (motion, touch, voltage or distance) into MIDI over USB, MIDI over Bluetooth LE, or OSC over Wi-Fi, and is configured from a web page hosted on the module itself. No app, driver or internet connection is needed.

## Products

- [Pipo Motion](https://pipointerfaces.com/modules/pipomotion.html): Wireless motion controller with a 9-axis IMU (ICM-20948: accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer). Outputs absolute and relative orientation (Euler angles, quaternions over OSC), gestures, taps and vibrations. Low latency and can be attached anywhere (strap included on Crowd Supply).
- [Pipo Analog](https://pipointerfaces.com/modules/pipoanalog.html): Wireless input board with 8 voltage inputs on 4 Grove connectors and 8 capacitive touch inputs. Inputs 1/2 and 7/8 have selectable 3.3 V / 5 V / 12 V ranges, and inputs 3 to 6 accept up to 3.3 V. All inputs have overvoltage and reverse-polarity protection. Solder pads allow direct wiring. Connect switches, potentiometers or analog sensors, or turn any metal object into a touch trigger.
- [Pipo Range](https://pipointerfaces.com/modules/piporange.html): Wireless distance controller using a VL53L1CB Time-of-Flight sensor (60 Hz, 27° field of view). Play it like a theremin with your hand (up to about 80 cm), or detect people and objects approaching (up to 3 m). Resistant to ambient light. It has an optional "hold" mode.
- Pipo Set: Motion + Analog + Range bundle.

## Where to buy

- Europe and UK: [Pipo Shop (Big Cartel)](https://pipo-shop.bigcartel.com/products). Prices in EUR include VAT. It sells Pipo Motion, Pipo Analog, Pipo Range, the Pipo Set and Grove sensors/cables. Ships from Belgium.
- Worldwide: [Crowd Supply](https://www.crowdsupply.com/pipo-interfaces/pipo). Pipo Motion ($159) and the Pipo Set ($396) are available for pre-order there, along with Grove accessories.

## Common features

- Outputs: OSC over Wi-Fi (local network or direct connection to the module), MIDI over Bluetooth Low Energy (mobile and macOS friendly), and class-compliant USB MIDI over USB-C (any OS, no driver).
- Browser-based configuration page hosted on the module. You can adjust ranges, thresholds, inversion, binary/cyclic modes and MIDI/OSC mappings live, and save multiple configurations.
- Embedded rechargeable battery with USB-C charging.
- Wi-Fi access point and station modes (connect directly or through a router).
- Firmware updates are done from the browser (Chrome, Edge or Opera) at https://pipointerfaces.com/update/
- Built on the Espressif ESP32-S3.
- Works with Ableton Live, TouchDesigner, Max/MSP, Pure Data, VCV Rack, MadMapper, Bespoke, Isadora, Resolume, openFrameworks and any MIDI or OSC software.

## Use cases

Live music performance, expressive MIDI control, interactive art installations, motion-controlled lighting and video, theremin-style instruments, audiovisual performance, dance and wearable sensing, creative coding and physical computing, and education.
